notes.title: UI and save fix patch
notes.notes:
New version: 25.5.7

Hello everyone!

This patch includes 

- UI fixes: mostly in the phone, like preventing double inputs, navigation stuck on an app or stuff suddenly not responding. Also prevented double inputs in the flying carpet menu and navigation loss in the standalone settings menu.

- Save/load fixes: loading at some specific location under some specific conditions could break the game, or make some stuff break.

- Bug fix: going next to the shop after getting Hoop could sometimes disable the controls.

- Missing translations and wrong controller input prompts.

Have a good day!

notes.title: Super save patch
notes.notes:
New version: 25.1.1

Hello everyone,

It's been a long time. Sorry I didn't reply to the posts on the forum. I wasn't that available because I moved to another country, and then I ended up catching a bad flu...

This patch introduces a new feature: the "super save". It's basically a special save that you get when finishing the game. The save starts on College Lantern, and, even if the game hasn't really caught up with the events happening in the Palace [spoiler](and Simurgh's release)[/spoiler], the state of your inventories is the same as the one from the end of the game (essentially, there's 30 birds registered on your phone). This save can be used to complete optional parts of the game such as the achievements. It's marked with a yellow star in the phone and on the title screen. All subsequent saves are marked as well (yellow star = post complete game save).
You can also finish the game again from one of these saves but some stuff are going to be different (and faster):
[spoiler]- in the Palace, the instrument is already there and you already have the documentation (so you can play direcly, just talk to the guy beside the instrument)
- in the Dream Lantern, you already have the items to complete each dialogue
- the doesn't change and you can make another choice
[/spoiler]

Other fixes:
- texts
- naked bird dress-up game controls (now, it's always an available feather that gets selected, except if there's no feather anymore in the selected box - also better selection highlights)
- camera issues on Park Lantern
- Dream Lantern
- "Destroyer" (dash) achievement
- WASD supported in Death's challenge QTE

As always, thanks a lot to all the players who reported the issues. You rock!

notes.title: Star collecting achievement patch
notes.notes:
New version: 24.22.6

Happy new year everyone! Hope you're doing great.

Now onto this day's patch:

The "Stargazer" achievement was triggered by having collected 4 stars, that is: having at some point 4 stars in your inventory.
This was very counter-intuitive [spoiler]because you're encouraged to give the stars back to the constellations (and you even MUST give one star away to get a bird and progress in the game)[/spoiler] so we changed it so you only have to have found 4 stars during the game to get the achievement.

Best wishes!

notes.title: New update and Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Dear players,

Thank you again for your love and support for 30 Birds! We are working with everything we have to improve the game and fix any bug you might encounter.

We pushed a new Windows/Mac version that brings the following issues:

- fixed cutscene blocker
- fixed last instrument
- fixed missing music and sfx
- tile game polish + new character
- fixed temple guardian animation
- fly comm polish
- fixed a hole in the fabric of the universe on Grand Bazaar Lantern

Do not hesitate to warn us if you encounter another bug. Let us pray Simurgh that it won't happen anymore though 😅 🐦‍🔥
